spells.name: Astral Projection
spells.description: Project astral forms for up to 8 creatures. Physical bodies stay in suspended animation. Soul connected by silver cord (cutting it kills you). Ends if astral HP reaches 0, dismissed, or return to body.

spells.name: Blade of Disaster
spells.description: Create planar rift blade. When cast and as a Bonus Action, move it 30ft and make two melee spell attacks: 4d12 Force damage. Crit on 18-20 (deals extra 8d12 Force). Passes through any barrier.

spells.name: Foresight
spells.description: Target cannot be Surprised and has Advantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws. Other creatures have Disadvantage on attacks against the target.

spells.name: Gate
spells.description: Create portal (5-20ft) to specific point on another plane. Can name a creature to draw it through (no save).

spells.name: Imprisonment
spells.description: Wisdom save or bind creature. Choose: Burial (underground), Chaining (chains), Hedged Prison (demiplane), Minimus Containment (gem), or Slumber (sleep). Ends only by set condition or L9 Dispel Magic.

spells.name: Mass Heal
spells.description: Restore up to 700 HP divided among any number of visible creatures. Removes Blinded, Deafened, and Poisoned. No effect on Undead/Constructs.

spells.name: Meteor Swarm
spells.description: Four 40ft-radius Sphere impacts. Each creature makes a Dexterity save. Fail: 20d6 Fire + 20d6 Bludgeoning damage. Success: half damage. Affected only once by overlapping spheres.

spells.name: Power Word Heal
spells.description: Target regains all HP. Ends Charmed, Frightened, Paralyzed, and Stunned. Target can stand up as a Reaction.

spells.name: Power Word Kill
spells.description: Compel creature to die. If it has 100 HP or fewer, it dies instantly.

spells.name: Prismatic Wall
spells.description: Create 90x30ft wall or 30ft sphere. Opaque, prevents passage. 7 layers: Red (10d6 Fire), Orange (10d6 Acid), Yellow (10d6 Lightning), Green (10d6 Poison), Blue (10d6 Cold), Indigo (Petrify), Violet (Banish).

spells.name: Shapechange
spells.description: Transform into any creature (CR <= your level). Assume its HP/HD. Retain alignment/personality. Action to swap forms during duration.

spells.name: Storm of Vengeance
spells.description: 360ft-radius cloud. Round 1: 2d6 Thunder + Deafened. Round 2: Acid rain (1d6). Round 3: Lightning (5d6). Round 4: Hail (2d6 Bludg). Rounds 5-10: Cold/Wind.

spells.name: Time Stop
spells.description: Take 1d4 + 1 turns in a row. Ends if you affect another creature or its worn/carried items.

spells.name: True Polymorph
spells.description: Transform creature/object. If held for 1h, lasts until 0 HP or dispelled. Creature to Creature (CR <= target), Creature to Object, or Object to Creature (CR 9-).

spells.name: True Resurrection
spells.description: Revive creature dead <200 years (not old age). Returns with all HP. Closes wounds, removes all conditions/curses. Provides new body if needed.

spells.name: Weird
spells.description: 30ft-radius Sphere burst. Wisdom save or Frightened. While Frightened, take 4d10 Psychic damage at start of turns. Repeat save at end of turns.

spells.name: Wish
spells.description: Duplicate any L8- spell (no components needed). Or: create 25k GP object, heal 20 creatures, grant Resistance, or set a reality-altering event. Stress rules apply for non-duplicate uses.

spells.name: Invulnerability
spells.description: You are immune to all damage until the spell ends.

spells.name: Mass Polymorph
spells.description: Transform up to 10 creatures (Wisdom save to resist; Shapechangers auto-succeed). Targets assume Beast form (CR <= target CR/level/2). Gain Temp HP of new form; reverts when Temp HP gone or dies.

spells.name: Psychic Scream
spells.description: Blast intellect of up to 10 creatures. Intelligence save or take 14d6 Psychic damage and Stunned. If killed, head explodes. Repeat save at end of turns.

spells.name: Ravenous Void
spells.description: 20ft-radius Sphere of gravitational force. Area within 100ft is Difficult Terrain. Creatures/unsecured objects pulled toward center. Sphere deals 5d10 Force damage and Restrains. Target reduced to 0 HP is annihilated.

spells.name: Time Ravage
spells.description: Rapid aging. Constitution save or 10d12 Necrotic damage. If failed, target ages to 30 days left of life (halved Speed, Disadv on checks/saves). Only Wish or L9 Greater Restoration restores age.
